scope: Per-file geometry slicing only; assumed200x200mm bed. Temperatures0; G-code is diagnostic and must not be printed. Supports45deg,4PETG/3TPUperimeters,gyroid; actual machine/material tolerances and supports accessibility not validated.
retry_policy: External process exit must be zero and actual GCODE must pass geometry/unit/layer checks; previously successful identical STL/profile results are retained.
